title: Hausdorff measure of compact and relatively open pieces of a Simon submanifold
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞ and M ⊆ ℝᴺ an n-dimensional C^r Simon submanifold (Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) r M, which includes r ≥ 1). Then (a) μHE[n](C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ M, and (b) μHE[n](M ∩ O) > 0 for every y ∈ M and every open O ⊆ ℝᴺ with y ∈ O.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → (∀ C ⊆ M, IsCompact C → μHE[n] C < ⊤) ∧ ∀ y ∈ M, ∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → y ∈ O → 0 < μHE[n] (M ∩ O)
